articles.summary: TRISHNA, a collaborative Earth-observation mission between India's ISRO and France's CNES, is a Thermal Infra-Red Imaging Satellite. Its primary goal is high-resolution natural resource assessment, providing critical data for environmental monitoring and management. This international partnership highlights advancements in space technology for global benefit, focusing on detailed thermal imaging of Earth's surface for scientific research.

articles.title: PNB to enter wealth management services, beef up credit card portfolio
articles.summary: State-run lender PNB is actively pursuing new growth strategies. It aims to launch wealth management services by early 2027 and is significantly expanding its credit card portfolio, adding 50,000-60,000 cards each month. These moves highlight the bank's focus on diversifying revenue streams and strengthening its presence in key financial sectors within the national economy.

articles.title: PM Modi hails India's space success in virtual address to Paris Space Summit
articles.summary: PM Modi virtually addressed the International Space Summit in Paris, emphasizing India's significant progress in space exploration. His participation highlighted India's growing global stature and technological capabilities in the space sector. This engagement underscores the nation's commitment to advancing its space program and contributing to international scientific collaboration, reflecting India's strength in critical emerging technologies.

articles.title: Indian regional airlines to buy 105 Russian planes
articles.summary: Three Indian airlines have agreed to procure 105 Russian Il-114-300 passenger aircraft, significantly expanding civil aviation and manufacturing cooperation between India and Russia. This move strengthens bilateral ties, boosting India's domestic air travel capacity and fostering joint industrial development. It underscores a strategic partnership beyond traditional defence, enhancing economic collaboration in the aerospace sector.

This case underscores the increasing sophistication of cyber financial crimes and the critical need for enhanced digital security measures in the cryptocurrency domain.

articles.title: Captcha Design Festival
articles.summary: Captcha is a design festival set to explore design not merely as a finished product, but as an evolving, ongoing process. Commencing September 14th, the event encourages active participation through watching, discussing, and engaging with various design aspects. It aims to offer a comprehensive platform for understanding the dynamic and transformative nature of design, inviting a deeper dive into its continuous development.

articles.title: US and Philippine marines train with BrahMos to deter China
articles.summary: US and Philippine forces recently conducted a joint exercise, simulating the potent BrahMos anti-ship missile. This involved establishing a 'kill chain' using drones and ground-based missiles, a critical component of modern maritime defence. The exercise helps Philippine Marines refine tactics for the BrahMos system, acquired in 2022, enhancing their coastal defence capabilities and interoperability in the region.
